name: buffett-munger-team
description: Buffett & Munger value investment advisory team — simulates Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger to help ordinary investors analyze stocks and make investment decisions.

displayDescription.en: Simulates Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger's thinking to help ordinary investors analyze stocks through value investing frameworks, identify moats, assess safety margins, and make rational investment decisions.
